svg.title: Johansson Heights Minato · 1F plan
svg.text: Shops to the plaza, the entrance hall inside the autolock, the building’s services behind.
Blue Coral Ice Cream · ブルーコーラル
shop: ice cream; freezer counter, two chest freezers, a sink with a grease trap · door: south and west
Rainflower Florist · レインフラワー花店
shop: flowers, and the town’s supplier of decorations; a flower cooler, a sink, display on the walkway · door: west
Entrance hall · エントランス
autolock door and intercom panel, 38 mailboxes, delivery lockers, notice board · door: south (from the walkway)
Lift lobby · エレベーターホール
lift and stair, inside the autolock · door: —
window to the hall; fire alarm panel, intercom master, lift monitor; caretaker 9:00–17:00 · door: hall
the building’s low-voltage boards; no water pipe passes through it (stack SS2 drops in a chase on the hall’s side of its wall) · door: lift lobby
Utility transformer room · 借室電気室
the utility’s 6,600 V switchgear and transformers, let to it; its own door from outside, open to the utility at all hours · door: east (from outside)
receiving tank, booster pump set, water meter; floor drain and the tank overflow to the storm drain through an air break · door: east
burnable, non-burnable, cans and bottles; a tap and a floor drain · door: north and east
ヨハンソンハイツ港町
The transformer room is the utility’s, let to it, with its own door from outside; no
water pipe passes over it or the electrical room.
The three stacks turn under the slab into the building drain, which runs in the east
FOR DESIGN REVIEW · Rev A · a game asset's design basis, not for construction · metres unless noted
